description: MyCarTracks connects ChatGPT to your mileage tracking and vehicle tracking workflows. Ask about trips, routes, vehicle activity, mileage logs, reimbursements, reports, geofences, expenses, dispatch work, and maintenance details using your MyCarTracks data. It helps self-employed drivers and business teams get quicker answers from their driving and fleet records without opening reports manually.

defaultPrompt: Show my latest business drives from MyCarTracks.
Which vehicles were used the most this month? Rank them by total distance
